title: Synthetic Data Generation and Model Training API
summary: A FastAPI service that generates synthetic tabular data, augments datasets, trains ML models, and evaluates synthetic data quality via REST endpoints. It directly imports and instantiates SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, and CopulaGANSynthesizer alongside SingleTableMetadata and sdmetrics' QualityReport to run its core synthesis and evaluation logic.
